explanation.summary: Mass cancels out of the small-angle period formula — a heavier bob swings at the same rate.
explanation.misconception: A heavier pendulum bob swings faster than a lighter one.
explanation.correctModel: For small angles, T = 2π√(L/g); mass does not appear.
